comment: Remediation acceptance baseline (plan section 0.3). pre_tag is the tree before the first remediation commit; the checker derives LOC solely from git diff pre_tag..HEAD and verifies every removal-ledger tree claim against it. no_relevant_kinds is the committed, exhaustive NO-relevant classification over BOTH kind registries (refusal_event_kinds.json and terminal_no_kinds.json): every registered kind must appear here exactly once, so adding a kind without classifying it fails ship — additions are data-file diffs visible in git, never runtime-invented kinds. watchdog-deadline is pinned false (a bound, per section 0.2: the deadline knob cannot manufacture the terminal event the instrument rewards) and blocking_written is pinned excluded (a consumable coordination signal, per section 0.4). External (out-of-repo) artifact citations verify tri-state: digest checked when the path is readable on this machine, a loud NOTE when it is not — never silently green, never a ship failure on a machine without the retained runs; an in-repo citation always verifies strictly.

baseline_rows.caveat: pre-instrumentation run: timestamps are file mtimes plus embedded unix stamps, NOT signed host events — exactly the gap plan sections 0.1/0.2 close for future runs (extraction: channel #22, kindex a23ab68a8abd)
